title: He Walked Home Drunk Instead of Driving and STILL Got Arrested
description:
An Ohio man tried making the right call by walking home after a Halloween party with his co-workers. Dressed in his make-shift costume, Lakewood officers approached him after noting he “couldn’t walk straight.” What happened next left “Batman” in the back of a cop car.

Subscribe to Law&Crime BodyCam: https://bit.ly/LawAndCrimeBodyCam
